system.description:
MIRAKU

You have learned to receive violence as the mountain receives the storm: without yielding.

Prerequisites Mujina Heritage

When you use Impact Stance, your Base DR increases by 2 against the triggering attack rather than 1. Furthermore, if the attack still inflicts damage, you gain a +2 racial bonus to checks and saving throws made to avoid being knocked prone or moved against your will by that attack.

Automated: your Impact Absorption raises your Base DR by 2 instead of 1 (the book's "Impact Stance" is read as Impact Absorption, the Mujina's reaction). The +2 racial bonus against being knocked prone or moved by that attack is offered as a tick on your checks and saves.

conditionals.label: Bear's Endurance
conditionals.scope: Checks and saving throws to avoid being knocked prone or moved against your will — tick if this roll is one, against an attack you absorbed with Impact Absorption that still damaged you
